articles.title: Stock market surges: Why Angel One, BSE, Motilal Oswal and Groww shares are rallying sharply today
articles.summary: Capital market-linked stocks witnessed strong buying interest in early trade as broader markets staged a sharp recovery, with the Nifty reclaiming the 24,200 mark amid improving global sentiment.
articles.body: Shares of Angel One rose over 6% intraday, while BSE Ltd gained nearly 3%. Motilal Oswal Financial Services also moved higher, alongside strong traction in Groww, which is now almost doubled from its IPO price reflecting broad-based momentum across the capital markets ecosystem.  The rally comes as investor sentiment turned positive following reports of renewed diplomatic engagement between Iran and the United States. Market participants are closely tracking developments suggesting that both nations may meet again this week in Islamabad for another round of talks, raising hopes that tensions in the region may not escalate further.  This easing geopolitical anxiety has lifted global markets, with Asian indices trading higher and US markets closing in the green in the previous session. The improved risk appetite has translated into strong buying across equities, particularly in high-beta segments like capital market stocks.  Capital market companies tend to outperform during periods of market strength as rising indices typically lead to higher trading volumes, increased investor participation, and stronger brokerage revenues. The sharp uptick in volumes and sentiment-driven activity is often reflected quickly in their stock prices.  Additionally, the rebound in benchmark indices has triggered fresh interest from retail and institutional investors, further supporting stocks linked to trading, broking, and exchange businesses.  With global cues stabilising and domestic indices recovering, capital market stocks remain in focus, as they are among the key beneficiaries of any sustained uptrend in market activity.

articles.title: Sensex jumps 1,200 points: 3 reasons why stock market is rising today
articles.summary: At around 9:48 am, the BSE Sensex was up 1,217.31 points, or 1.58%, at 78,064.88. It opened at 77,981.10 and touched a high of 78,270.42, while the low stood at 77,849.52.
articles.body: Stock markets opened strong on Wednesday morning, with both Sensex and Nifty rising sharply , helped by positive global cues, falling oil prices and broad buying across sectors.  At around 9:48 am, the BSE Sensex was up 1,217.31 points, or 1.58%, at 78,064.88. It opened at 77,981.10 and touched a high of 78,270.42, while the low stood at 77,849.52.  The NSE Nifty 50 was trading at 24,218.35, up 375.70 points or 1.58%. The index opened at 24,163.80 and hit a high of 24,280.90, with the day's low at 24,145.80.  Here are the three main reasons behind today's market rise:  TALKS HOPE BETWEEN US AND IRAN  The biggest trigger for the rally is the growing hope that talks between the United States and Iran may restart soon . There are also signs of talks between Israel and Lebanon, which has helped improve global sentiment.  Dr. VK Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist at Geojit Investments Limited, said, “Hopes of resumption of US-Iran talks, Israel-Lebanon talks and crash in Brent crude by $10 dollars in two days augur well for the market in the near-term.”  He added, “The resilience of markets worldwide, despite the IMF's warning about a global recession if the conflict prolongs, is an indication that the market is discounting an end to the conflict soon.”  This has reduced fears of a wider conflict and supported equity markets globally, including India.  OIL PRICES FALL BELOW $100  Another key reason is the fall in crude oil prices. Brent crude was trading at $95.07, up 0.27%, while WTI crude stood at $90.89, down 0.43%. Oil prices have slipped below the $100 mark, which is seen as a relief for India.  Lower oil prices reduce pressure on inflation and help improve the country's trade balance. This is positive for sectors like banking, auto and consumer goods, which depend on stable costs.  The sharp fall in crude prices over the last two days has played a direct role in lifting market sentiment.  BROAD-BASED BUYING ACROSS DALAL STREET  The rally is not limited to a few stocks. There is strong buying across large-cap stocks and sectors.  Among the top gainers were IndusInd Bank, Larsen & Toubro, TCS, Eternal, Adani Ports and Infosys, all rising between around 2% and 4%. Other stocks like Asian Paints, UltraTech Cement, Bajaj Finance, HDFC Bank, Titan and Reliance Industries also saw solid gains.  On the other hand, only a few stocks like ICICI Bank and Sun Pharma saw slight declines.  Sector-wise, all major indices were trading in the green. Nifty IT rose 2.54%, Nifty Media gained 2.43%, and Nifty Metal was up 1.85%. Nifty Financial Services, Auto, PSU Bank and Oil & Gas indices also posted gains of over 1%.  This shows that the rally is broad-based, with participation from multiple sectors rather than just a few heavyweights.  WHAT SHOULD INVESTORS WATCH  Dr. Vijayakumar advised investors to stay invested during such volatile phases.  “In the extremely volatile scenario through which markets have been moving, it is important that investors remain invested. The benefit from sharp rebounds in the market will be lost to investors who sell out and keep away from the market,” he said.  He also noted that large-cap stocks may see a strong comeback in the near term, but could face pressure again if foreign investors resume selling.  “The excellent performance of South Korean and Taiwanese markets and the significant market momentum there might nudge FPIs to sell again in India,” he said.  He added that mid- and small-cap stocks may remain more stable, as they are less affected by foreign investor selling.  For now, the market mood remains positive, driven by hopes of easing global tensions, lower oil prices and strong buying across sectors. articles.title: IT earnings Q4FY26: Focus on deals, acquisitions, and share buyback at Wipro's upcoming earnings meet
articles.summary: Analysts expect the company to post muted revenue growth for Q4, along with residual margin impact from acquisitions and clarity on the proposed share buyback.
articles.body: After Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. reported its first-ever full-year decline in dollar revenue growth, Bengaluru-based Wipro Ltd. is set to announce its financial results on April 17.  In January, the company had guided that its IT services segment revenue for Q4FY26 would be in the range of $2,635 million to $2,688 million, implying a growth outlook of 0% to -2% in constant currency terms. However, market analysts expect the company's quarterly performance to come in below the midpoint of this guidance range.  Brokerage forecasts  Nomura analysts expect sequential revenue growth of 0.8% quarter-on-quarter in constant currency. They also anticipate the company will guide for revenue growth in the range of -1% to +1% in constant currency for Q1 FY27. “We expect adjusted EBIT margins to remain stable due to ramp-up cost of recently won large deals with upfront cost savings given to customers largely offset by currency gains. In Q3, reported margins had impact of provisions made for labour code changes,” a sectorial note by the brokerage said.  Other brokerages such as Centrum and PL capital expect the sequential constant current revenue growth to be 0.6% and 0.8%, respectively, largely on the back of deals wins and ramp ups.  While Wipro completed the $375-million acquisition of Harman Digital Transformation Services in the previous quarter to strengthen its engineering capabilities, both PL Capital and Motilal Oswal Financial Services expect margin contraction to reflect in the current quarter. PL Capital estimates a 30-basis points quarter-on-quarter decline, primarily due to the residual two-month impact of Harman integration while Motilal Oswal sees margins to be weighed down by Harman DTS-related dilution, wage hikes, and slower growth.  Earlier this month, Wipro announced a large deal win with Singapore-headquartered Olam Group, a food and agri-business conglomerate. The eight-year, end-to-end transformation deal is expected to exceed $1 billion in total contract value, with a committed spend of $800 million.  As part of the deal, Wipro will acquire Mindsprint, Olam Group's IT services arm, for $375 million, with the transaction expected to close in the quarter ending Q1FY27. In its report on the acquisition, Emkay Research noted that while Harman DTS is likely to contribute around 3% to revenue, it has not factored this into its Q4 estimates due to the pending deal closure. It also estimates that Mindsprint could contribute around 1.3% to revenue.  Markets will also be looking for details on the proposed buyback. On April 9, in its communication to stock exchanges, Wipro said it would consider a proposal for a buyback of equity shares at its upcoming board meeting. This follows the company's 2023 buyback, under which it repurchased 26.96 crore equity shares at a price of ₹445 per share, amounting to a total outlay of ₹12,000 crore. articles.body: अपने एक्टिव निवेशकों की संख्या में रिकॉर्ड गिरावट दर्ज की है। पिछले तीन वर्षों में यह पहली बार है जब निवेशकों की संख्या बढ़ने के बजाय घटी है, और यह गिरावट अब तक की सबसे बड़ी गिरावट है।35 लाख निवेशकों ने किया किनाराNSE के आंकड़ों के मुताबिक, एक्टिव निवेशकों का आंकड़ा 7 प्रतिशत तक गिर गया है। वित्त वर्ष 2025 में एक्टिव अकाउंट्स की संख्या 4.92 करोड़ थी, जो वित्त वर्ष 2026 में घटकर 4.58 करोड़ रह गई है। कुल गिरावट का 70% हिस्सा यानी करीब 26 लाख अकाउंट्स केवल तीन बड़े डिस्काउंट ब्रोकर्स जेरोधा, एंजेल वन और अपस्टॉक्स के खाते से कम हुए है।जेरोधा, एंजेल वन और अपस्टॉक्स, किसे कितना नुकसान?मार्केट लीडर्स कहे जाने वाले ब्रोकर्स के क्लाइंट्स में भारी कमी आई है:Zerodha: सबसे ज्यादा 9.95 लाख एक्टिव निवेशक खोए। कुल गिरावट में इसकी भागीदारी 29% है।Angel One: इसके खाते से 8.15 लाख निवेशक कम हुए, कुल गिरावट का 23% है।Upstox: यहां 7.6 लाख निवेशकों ने ट्रेड करना बंद कर दिया है जो कुल गिरावट का 22% है।एचडीएफसी सिक्योरिटीज, शेयरखान, मोतीलाल ओसवाल और कोटक सिक्योरिटीज जैसे पारंपरिक ब्रोकर्स ने भी 1 लाख से ज्यादा क्लाइंट्स खोए हैं।आखिर क्यों भागे निवेशक? ये हैं 5 बड़े कारणबाजार विशेषज्ञों ने इस गिरावट के पीछे कई वैश्विक और घरेलू कारणों को जिम्मेदार ठहराया है:मिडिल ईस्ट युद्ध: अमेरिका-ईरान-इजरायल संघर्ष ने निवेशकों के भरोसे को तोड़ दिया है।महंगा तेल और महंगाई: कच्चे तेल की कीमतें $100 प्रति बैरल के पार जाने से महंगाई और राजकोषीय घाटे का डर बढ़ गया है।विदेशी निवेशकों (FII) की बिकवाली: विदेशी ब्रोकरेज फर्म्स जैसे गोल्डमैन सैक्स और मॉर्गन स्टैनली ने भारतीय बाजार को 'न्यूट्रल' या 'अंडरवेट' कैटेगरी में डाल दिया है, जिससे लगातार बिकवाली हो रही है।AI थीम की कमी: विश्लेषकों का मानना है कि भारत में बड़े पैमाने पर AI से जुड़ी निवेश थीम की कमी है, जिससे विदेशी निवेशक अब ताइवान या अन्य बाजारों की ओर रुख कर रहे हैं।सुस्त IPO मार्केट: कई नए आईपीओ की कमजोर लिस्टिंग ने रिटेल निवेशकों के उत्साह को ठंडा कर दिया है।इन ब्रोकर्स ने विपरीत लहर में भी मारी बाजीजहां बड़े दिग्गज गिर रहे थे, वहीं कुछ मिड-साइज ब्रोकर्स ने नए निवेशक जोड़ने में सफलता पाई:Paytm Money: इस साल का सबसे बड़ा विनर रहा, जिसने 2.12 लाख नए एक्टिव निवेशक जोड़े।SBICAP और ICICI Securities: इन्होंने क्रमशः 1.82 लाख और 1.41 लाख नए क्लाइंट्स बनाए।Groww: मामूली बढ़त के साथ 17,917 नए अकाउंट्स जोड़ने में सफल रहा।नोमुरा ने निफ्टी पर घटाया टारगेटइन्हीं सब के बीच ग्लोबल ब्रोकरेज फर्म Nomura ने भारतीय इक्विटी पर अपना रुख कड़ा कर लिया है। नोमुरा ने निफ्टी 50 के लिए अपने टारगेट को घटाकर 24,500–24,900 के स्तर पर ला दिया है। इसका मुख्य कारण भारतीय शेयरों का अत्यधिक महंगा होना और तेल की बढ़ती कीमतें हैं।

articles.title: Sensex jumps 1,300 points on falling crude prices, US-Iran talks
articles.summary: India's benchmark stock indices, the Sensex and Nifty , opened sharply higher on Wednesday. The surge comes after a decline in crude oil prices and renewed hopes of US-Iran talks.
articles.body: At 10:45am, the Sensex was up by 1,313 points or 1.7% at 78,160 while the broader Nifty rose to a high of 24,254, up by 412 points.  Top gainers and losers  The market witnessed a broad-based rally with InterGlobe Aviation leading the charge with over 4% gains. Other major gainers included Hindalco, Shriram Finance, UltraTech Cement, Adani Enterprises, Infosys and Larsen & Toubro—all rising between 2% and 3.5%. Dr Reddy's Laboratories emerged as the top loser with a decline of about 2.7%.  Global cues  The positive start of the Indian market was aided by a firm trend in GIFT Nifty, signaling a gap-up opening on improving global cues. Asian markets were trading higher while Wall Street extended gains overnight. The NASDAQ rose 2% marking its 10th consecutive day of gains with S&P 500 nearing record highs. Crude oil prices declined for the second consecutive session with Brent falling below $95 per barrel amid reports that US-Iran talks could resume soon.  Market expert's opinion  VK Vijayakumar of Geojit Investments said, "Hopes of resumption of US-Iran talks and the sharp fall in Brent crude augur well for markets in the near term." He added that global markets seem to be pricing in an eventual end to the conflict. Despite a strong opening, experts warn that rally sustainability will depend on continued positive geopolitical developments and sustained buying interest.

articles.title: RailTel Corporation Drops 6.4% on 52-Week Low Zone + Railway PSU Sector De-Rating — Is This a Buying Opportunity or a Warning?
articles.summary: of India (NSE: RAILTEL) fell 6.4% on Sunday April 13, 2026, breaching a critical technical support zone at Rs 293 — just Rs 48 above its 52-week low.
articles.body: The stock has now surrendered 39% from its 2024 peak of Rs 479, making it one of the largest wealth destroyers in the Railway PSU basket that was once the market's most loved theme.  With Rs 2.93 lakh crore allocated for Indian Railways in the Union Budget 2026–27 — a record — the paradox is stark: the company that provides the telecom backbone for all of Indian Railways' 7,000+ stations is trading near a 2-year low. Is the market missing the structural story, or is it pricing in execution realities that the bull case ignores?  Get SEBI-registered analyst research on railway PSU stocks on Univest  Event at a Glance  Why the Market Is Selling RailTel  Access SEBI-registered research on RailTel Corporation on the Univest Screener  Railway PSU Sector-Wide De-Rating  The railway PSU basket — RVNL, IRFC, RailTel, IRCON — has collectively lost 40–65% from 2024 peaks as the market recalibrated over-extended valuations. RailTel at 27x trailing P/E was priced for 25%+ earnings growth; actual Q3 FY26 growth came in at 6.9% YoY. The gap between price expectations and earnings reality is still being corrected.  Order Book Execution Pace  RailTel's order book stands at Rs 5,800 crore — but execution pace has slowed. Government IT and telecom projects, particularly under BharatNet Phase 3 and railway signalling contracts, face delays due to state-level coordination bottlenecks. Order-to-revenue conversion time has stretched from 18 months to 24+ months.  FII Selling in PSU Infrastructure Basket  Foreign institutional investors have exited the PSU infrastructure theme in a coordinated fashion since Q1 FY26. FII holding in RailTel has dropped from 3.4% to 1.8% in three quarters — a structural allocation exit, not tactical repositioning.  Competition from Private Telecom Operators  Reliance Jio and Airtel are competing with RailTel on government fibre and enterprise connectivity contracts. RailTel's historical competitive moat — its unique right-of-way on Indian Railways tracks — is a structural advantage, but pricing pressure is intensifying as private players pursue government contracts aggressively.  The Bull Case: Why Rs 293 Could Be the Bottom  Kavach (automatic train protection) rollout contracts are accelerating — RailTel is a key implementation partner, and 2,000+ km of Kavach deployment is scheduled for FY27.  Data centre expansion at Gurugram and Secunderabad — with Rs 350 crore capital expenditure committed — provides non-traditional revenue above railway-linked volatility.  Motilal Oswal targets Rs 420, with the thesis that BharatNet Phase 3's Rs 1.39 lakh crore tender pipeline will create 3-year visibility for RailTel's telecom segment.  The Nuance the Market May Be Missing  The nuance most retail investors miss: RailTel is not just a railway company — its Wi-Fi at 6,100+ stations handles 3 crore daily users, its data centres serve 200+ government entities, and its National Knowledge Network provides internet to 10,000+ academic institutions. These non-railway revenue streams are growing 22% annually — yet the market prices RailTel entirely on the railway capex cyclical narrative. articles.title: Market Opening Bell: Sensex surges over 1,100 points, Nifty above 24,150, Indigo top gainer
articles.summary: I ndian equity benchmark indices, the Sensex and Nifty, opened gap up on Wednesday, amid strong global cues as Brent crude has crashed by USD 10 dollars in two days.
articles.body: While the 30-share BSE Sensex added 1,133.53 points or 1.47 per cent to start the session at 77,981.10, the Nifty gained 321.15 points to open at 24,163.80. In the last trading session, the Sensex closed at 76,847.57 and the Nifty 50 at 23,842.65. Similarly, the broader indices traded in the green in the opening session. While the BSE Midcap Select Index added 311.07 points, the BSE Smallcap Select Index was up by 141.18 points or 1.85 per cent, to trade at 7,755.50.  All 30 stocks from the Sensex pack were in the green in the opening session, with Indigo being the biggest gainer with a jump of 4.41 per cent. UltraTech Cement, Asian Paints, Infosys, and Larsen & Toubro were other stocks among the top gainers.  In early trade, market breadth was positive, with 2,524 stocks advancing against only 138 stocks declining on the NSE. 50 stocks remained unchanged.  "We believe 24100/78100 would act as a key resistance zone for traders. As long as the market trades below this level, weak sentiment is likely to continue. On the downside, it could retest the 23,600-23,500/76600-76300 levels. On the other hand, above 24100/78100, sentiment could change. Above this level, it could move towards 24300/78700. If Nifty closes above this level, further upside momentum could continue, taking the index to 24,500/79300," said Shrikant Chouhan, Head Equity Research, Kotak Securities.  What did Gift Nifty indicate?  Gift Nifty, an early indicator for the Nifty 50, indicated a strong positive start as it opened with a gain of 329 points at 24,206.50, compared to the previous close of 23,877.50. Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) offloaded equities worth Rs 1,983.18 crore on April 13, 2026. However, Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) remained net buyers with purchases of Rs 2,432.30 crore.  Asian Markets Today  Asian stocks inched higher on Wednesday, tracking Wall Street, as Brent crude plunged to USD 95 amid fading fears of supply disruptions. While Japan's Nikkei 225 added 557.61 points or 0.96 per cent to trade at 58,435, Hong Kong's Hang Seng was up by 258.68 points or 1 per cent. Similarly, South Korea's Kospi traded in the green with a gain of 168.70 points at the time of writing the report. Shanghai's SSE Composite index added by 14.82 points or 0.37 per cent. articles.title: Manappuram Finance Ltd Aktie (INE522D01027): Ist das Goldkredit-Geschäftsmodell stark genug für neuen Schwung?
articles.summary: Manappuram Finance Ltd INE522D01027  Manappuram Finance Ltd Aktie (INE522D01027): Ist das Goldkredit-Geschäftsmodell stark genug für neuen Schwung?
articles.body: 15.04.2026 - 07:15:35 | ad-hoc-news.de  Manappuram Finance setzt auf Goldkredite und Mikrofinanzierung in Indien – ein Modell mit hohem Potenzial in unsicheren Zeiten. Für Anleger in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz bietet es Diversifikation in Schwellenmärkten mit stabilen Renditen. ISIN: INE522D01027  Manappuram Finance Ltd, INE522D01027 - Foto: THN  Du suchst nach stabilen Chancen in aufstrebenden Märkten? Manappuram Finance Ltd, ein führender indischer Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), macht mit seinem Fokus auf Goldkredite und Mikrofinanzierung auf sich aufmerksam. Das Geschäftsmodell profitiert von Indiens wachsender Mittelklasse und dem kulturellen Vorliebe für Gold als Sicherheit, was es zu einer interessanten Option für diversifizierte Portfolios macht.  In Zeiten globaler Unsicherheiten bietet Manappuram eine Brücke zu Indiens boomender Wirtschaft. Das Unternehmen vergibt Kredite gegen Goldpfänder, ein bewährtes System mit niedrigen Ausfallquoten. Für dich als Investor in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz bedeutet das Zugang zu einem Sektor, der weniger von westlichen Zinszyklen abhängt.  Stand: 15.04.2026  von Lena Vogel, Redakteurin für Schwellenmärkte – Sie erklärt, warum indische Fintechs für europäische Portfolios relevant werden.  Das Kerngeschäftsmodell: Goldkredite als stabiler Kern  Manappuram Finance Ltd basiert auf einem einfachen, aber robusten Modell: Die Vergabe von Krediten gegen Goldpfänder. Kunden hinterlegen ihr Gold als Sicherheit, was die Ausfallrisiken minimiert, da Gold in Indien hochliquide ist. Dieses Segment macht den Großteil der Einnahmen aus und profitiert von steigenden Goldpreisen.  Neben Goldkrediten erweitert das Unternehmen sein Portfolio um Mikrofinanzierung, Wohneigentumskredite und Pkw-Finanzierungen. Diese Diversifikation reduziert die Abhängigkeit von einem einzigen Bereich. Du profitierst als Investor von der Skalierbarkeit, da Manappuram über 5.000 Filialen in ganz Indien verfügt und so eine breite Kundenbasis erreicht.  Das Modell ist zyklusresistent: In wirtschaftlichen Abschwüngen steigt die Nachfrage nach kurzfristigen Pfandkrediten, während Boomphasen das Mikrofinanzgeschäft ankurbeln. Im Vergleich zu Banken hat Manappuram Vorteile durch schnellere Genehmigungen und niedrigere Betriebskosten. Für europäische Anleger ist das eine Möglichkeit, von Indiens 7-Prozent-Wachstum indirekt teilzuhaben.  Die operative Effizienz zeigt sich in der hohen Asset-Qualität: Die Non-Performing-Assets-Rate bleibt niedrig, gestützt durch regulatorische Auflagen der Reserve Bank of India. Manappuram investiert zudem in Digitalisierung, um Filialen mit Online-Plattformen zu verknüpfen. Das stärkt die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit in einem Markt mit über 200 NBFCs.  Offizielle Quelle  Alle aktuellen Infos zu Manappuram Finance Ltd aus erster Hand auf der offiziellen Webseite des Unternehmens.  Zur offiziellen Homepage  Produkte, Märkte und Wettbewerbsposition  Die Produktpalette umfasst Gold- und Schmuckkredite als Kern, ergänzt durch Mikroloans für Kleinstunternehmen und Selbsthilfegruppen. Besonders das Mikrofinanzsegment wächst stark, da es Frauen und ländliche Haushalte anspricht. Manappuram bedient vor allem Süden und Westen Indiens, wo Goldbesitz hoch ist.  Der indische NBFC-Markt ist fragmentiert, mit Manappuram unter den Top-5. Wettbewerber wie Muthoot Finance dominieren ebenfalls Goldkredite, doch Manappuram differenziert sich durch Diversifikation in MSME-Kredite. Die Marktdurchdringung bleibt niedrig, mit Potenzial für Expansion in Nordindien.  Für dich relevant: Indiens Finanzinklusionsprogramme wie Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana treiben Nachfrage. Manappurams Fokus auf Retail-Kunden schafft Stabilität, im Gegensatz zu corporate-finanzierten NBFCs. Die Präsenz in 25 Bundesstaaten sorgt für geographische Streuung.  International expandiert das Unternehmen vorsichtig, z.B. in die UAE, was Deviseneinnahmen bringt. Technologische Upgrades wie App-basierte Kredite verbessern die Kundenerfahrung und senken Akquisekosten. Insgesamt positioniert sich Manappuram als Vollservice-NBFC mit Fokus auf Retail.  Stimmung und Reaktionen  YouTube-Analysen  Instagram-Trends  TikTok-Buzz  Strategische Schwerpunkte und Branchentreiber  Manappurams Strategie zielt auf 20-Prozent-Wachstum im Goldkreditbuch ab, parallel zur Ausweitung des Mikrofinanzsegments. Digitalisierung steht im Vordergrund: Eine App für Kredite und Rückzahlungen soll die Effizienz steigern. Partnerschaften mit Tech-Firmen unterstützen dies.  Branchentreiber sind Indiens Digital India-Initiative und steigende Goldimporte. Regulatorische Lockerungen für NBFCs erleichtern Kapitalaufnahme. Die Nachfrage nach Mikrokrediten wächst durch Ruralisierung und Frauen-Empowerment-Programme.  Das Unternehmen priorisiert Nachhaltigkeit, z.B. durch faire Kreditvergabe in ländlichen Gebieten. Expansion in Non-Gold-Segmente wie Vehicle Loans reduziert Saisonalität. Für langfristige Investoren bietet das Potenzial für Margenverbesserung.  Management fokussiert auf Cost-to-Income-Ratio unter 40 Prozent, um Rentabilität zu sichern. In einem Markt mit 15-Prozent-CAGR für NBFCs ist Manappuram gut positioniert. Du solltest die Quartalszahlen auf Assets under Management beobachten.  Warum Manappuram für Anleger in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz zählt  In Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz suchen viele Anleger nach Diversifikation jenseits von Eurozone-Aktien. Manappuram bietet Exposure zu Indiens Konsumboom, wo Gold als Inflationsschutz dient – ähnlich wie in Europa. Die Aktie notiert an der BSE/NSE in Rupien, zugänglich über Broker wie Consorsbank oder Swissquote.  Der Rupien-Wechselkurs schützt vor Euro-Schwankungen, und Dividenden (typisch 2-3 Prozent) bieten Yield. Im Vergleich zu DAX-Werten ist die Volatilität höher, aber mit niedriger Korrelation zu westlichen Märkten. Für ETF-Holder ergänzt es Emerging-Markets-Portfolios. articles.title: Stock markets surge in early trade amid hopes of resumption of US-Iran peace talks
articles.summary: MUMBAI: Equity benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty surged in early trade on Wednesday, mirroring a rally in global markets and a drop in crude oil
articles.body: prices below the USD 100 per barrel mark, amid hopes of renewed diplomatic engagement between the US and Iran.  The 30-share BSE Sensex jumped 1,422.85 points to 78,270.42 in early trade. The 50-share NSE Nifty climbed 438.25 points to 24,280.90.  All the 30-Sensex firms were trading in positive territory during initial trade. InterGlobe Aviation, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Eternal, Larsen & Toubro and Bajaj Finance were the major gainers.  Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, traded 0.26 per cent higher at USD 95.04 per barrel.  “Markets appear to be looking past immediate risks and are instead pricing in the possibility of renewed diplomatic engagement between the US and Iran. This change in narrative has led to a sharp correction in crude oil prices, which is a key positive for India given its dependence on energy imports,” Hariprasad K, Research Analyst and Founder, Livelong Wealth, said.  US President Donald Trump has said that the war with Iran is “close to over”, asserting that if he pulled up stakes right now, it would take Tehran 20 years to rebuild the country.  “I think it's close to over, yeah. I view it as very close to being over,” Trump told Fox News in an interview that will be telecast later Wednesday.  A US media report said on Tuesday that Trump said that a second round of talks with Iran could be held in Islamabad “over the next two days”.  In Asian markets, South Korea's benchmark Kospi, Japan's Nikkei 225 index, Shanghai's SSE Composite index and Hong Kong's Hang Seng index were trading higher.  US markets ended in positive territory on Tuesday. The Nasdaq Composite jumped 1.96 per cent, the S&P 500 climbed 1.18 per cent, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average edged higher by 0.66 per cent.  “Hopes of resumption of US-Iran talks, Israel-Lebanon talks and crash in Brent crude by 10 dollars in two days augur well for the market in the near-term,” V K Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Investments Limited, said.  Stock markets were closed on Tuesday on account of Dr Baba Saheb Ambedkar Jayanti.  Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) again offloaded equities worth Rs 1,983.18 crore on Monday after a day's breather, according to exchange data. Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) bought stocks worth Rs 2,432.30 crore.  On Monday, the Sensex tumbled 702.68 points or 0.91 per cent to settle at 76,847.57. The Nifty plunged 207.95 points or 0.86 per cent to end at 23,842.65.  Leave A Reply  Save my name, email, and website in this browser for the next time I comment.

articles.title: री-रेटिंग को तैयार FMCG Stock, मोतीलाल ओसवाल बुलिश; ₹500 के टारगेट के साथ BUY रेटिंग
articles.summary: बाजार शेयर बाजार री-रेटिंग को तैयार FMCG Stock, मोतीलाल ओसवाल बुलिश; ₹500 के टारगेट के साथ BUY रेटिंग
articles.body: LT Foods Stocks: दावत (Daawat) और रॉयल (Royal) जैसे ब्रांड्स के दम पर कंज्यूमर सेगमेंट अपनी खास पहचान रखने वाली कंपनी एलटी फूड्स ​इस समय एक ऐसे मोड़ पर है, जहां कंपनी की मजबूत फाइनेंशियल स्थिति और बाहरी हालात मिलकर इसे निवेश के लिहाज से मजबूत बना रहे हैं। ब्रोकरेज फर्म मोतीलाल ओसवाल (Motilal Oswal) का कहना है कि कंपनी की करीब 46 फीसदी कमाई अमेरिका से आती है। वहां दावत और रॉयल जैसे ब्रांड्स की वजह से कंपनी ने पहले 50 फीसदी टैरिफ का असर काफी हद तक संभाल लिया था। अब नए 10% टैरिफ के बाद उम्मीद है कि बिक्री बढ़ेगी, मुनाफा सुधरेगा और कंपनी को बेहतर दाम मिलेंगे। पहले जो पिछले छह महीनों में दबाव था, वह अब धीरे-धीरे फायदे में बदल सकता है।  मोतीलाल ओसवाल ने LT Foods पर BUY रेटिंग दी है। साथ ही प्रति शेयर टारगेट प्राइस 500 रुपये प्रति शेयर रखा है। बीते ट्रेडिंग सेशन (13 अप्रैल) का शेयर 406 रुपये पर बंद हुआ था। इस तरह मौजूदा भाव से स्टॉक में आगे करीब 23 फीसदी तक तगड़ा रिटर्न देखने को मिल सकता है।  ब्रोकरेज का अनुमान है कि FY25 से FY28 के बीच LT Foods की कमाई हर साल करीब 17% की दर से बढ़ सकती है। वहीं, कंपनी का मुनाफा (EBITDA और PAT) भी लगभग 18% की दर से बढ़ने की उम्मीद है। मोतीलाल ओसवाल ने कंपनी का मूल्यांकन FY28 की अर्निंग्स के आधार पर 17 गुना रखा है और इस आधार पर टारगेट प्राइस 500 रुपये तय किया है।  एलटी फूड्स के परफॉर्मेंस की बात करें, तो यह लॉन्ग टर्म में मल्टीबैगर स्टॉक रहा है। बीते दो साल में इसने निवेशकों को पैसा डबल किया है। निवेशकों को 100 फीसदी का रिटर्न मिला है। हालांकि, बीते एक साल में बाजार में भारी उतार-चढ़ाव के बीच शेयर ने करीब 15 फीसदी का अपसाइड दिखाया है। वहीं, 3 साल में शेयर ने 330 फीसदी और 5 साल में करीब 500 फीसदी का मल्टीबैगर रिटर्न निवेशकों को दिया है।  बुधवार को बीएसई पर स्टॉक में 2.7 फीसदी से ज्यादा की तेजी के साथ 417.10 पर कारोबर शुरू हुआ। सुबह 10:15 बजे तक के कारोबार में शेयर ने 420.80 रुपये का हाई और 410.40 का लो बनाया। बीएसई पर स्टॉक का मार्केट कैप 14,402 करोड़ रुपये से ज्यादा दर्ज किया गया।  मोतीलाल ओसवाल का कहना है कि फिलहाल कंपनी पर कच्चे माल की बढ़ती कीमतों का दबाव है। 2025 में बासमती धान की कीमतें करीब 12% बढ़ गई हैं, जिससे खासकर पंजाब के इलाकों में उत्पादन पर असर पड़ा है। इसका असर कंपनी के मुनाफे (ग्रॉस मार्जिन) पर भी पड़ा है। लेकिन इसके बावजूद, LT Foods अपनी मजबूत इन्वेंट्री मैनेजमेंट, अच्छे एक्सपोर्ट दाम (करीब 144 रुपये प्रति किलो) और बेहतर कैश मैनेजमेंट की वजह से इस दबाव को काफी हद तक संभाल पा रही है। इससे पता चलता है कि कंपनी बढ़ती लागत के बावजूद अपने मुनाफे को बचाने में सक्षम है।  कंपनी की फाइनेंशियल स्थिति भी पहले से मजबूत हुई है। LT Foods ने धीरे-धीरे अपना कर्ज कम किया है और पिछले कुछ सालों में इसकी कमाई और मुनाफा लगातार अच्छी रफ्तार से बढ़ा है। साथ ही, कंपनी के पास अच्छा कैश फ्लो भी है, जो इसे और मजबूत बनाता है। अच्छी बात यह है कि कंपनी के ऑर्गेनिक बिजनेस से जुड़ी बड़ी समस्या अब काफी हद तक खत्म हो गई है। फरवरी 2026 में अमेरिका के फैसले के बाद यूरोप पर लगने वाला टैक्स बहुत कम हो गया है। इससे कंपनी पर आने वाला बड़ा खर्च भी काफी घट गया है, जो एक सकारात्मक संकेत है।  ब्रोकरेज हाउस का कहना है कि US-इजराइल-ईरान संघर्ष ने नई चुनौतियां पैदा कर दी हैं। करीब 4 लाख मीट्रिक टन बासमती चावल रास्ते में है और शिपिंग खर्च 3-4 गुना तक बढ़ गया है। इससे कंपनियों के मुनाफे और नकदी पर दबाव बढ़ रहा है। प​श्चिम ए​शिया में चल रही अस्थिरता का असर LT Foods की कमाई पर भी पड़ सकता है, क्योंकि कंपनी का बड़ा हिस्सा निर्यात से आता है। हालांकि, बासमती चावल की कीमतों में थोड़ी गिरावट से कुछ राहत मिल रही है, लेकिन कुल मिलाकर लागत का दबाव बना हुआ है।  फिर भी, हाल ही में हुए दो हफ्ते के युद्धविराम से स्थिति में थोड़ी राहत के संकेत मिले हैं। अगर होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य फिर से सामान्य रूप से खुल जाता है और बाजार स्थिर होता है, तो एलटी फूड्स को फायदा मिल सकता है, खासकर इसलिए क्योंकि उसका नॉर्थ अमेरिका बिजनेस मजबूत है और वह मध्य पूर्व पर कम निर्भर है।  (डिस्क्लेमर: यहां शेयर में खरीदारी की सलाह ब्रोकरेज ने दी है। बाजार में निवेश जो​खिमों के अधीन है। निवेश संबंधी फैसला करने से पहले अपने एडवाइजर से परामर्श कर लें।)

articles.title: ICICI Pru Life Share: तिमाही नतीजे, डिविडेंड ऐलान के बाद इंश्योरेंस कंपनी पर 5 ब्रोकरेज बुलिश, 27% तक मुनाफे का दिया टारगेट
articles.summary: ICICI Pru Life Share: ICICI प्रूडेंशियल लाइफ ने Q4 में शानदार नतीजे पेश किए, जिसमें मुनाफा और VNB दोनों में मजबूत बढ़त रही। तिमाही नतीजों के बाद ज्यादातर ब्रोकरेज स्टॉक पर बुलिश हैं और 25–27% तक अपसाइड देख रहे हैं।
articles.body: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance ने वित्त वर्ष 2025-26 की चौथी तिमाही में मजबूत प्रदर्शन दिखाया है, जिसने ब्रोकरेज हाउसेज़ का भरोसा और बढ़ा दिया है। कंपनी का प्रॉफिट आफ्टर टैक्स (PAT) सालाना आधार पर 34.6% बढ़कर ₹1,600 करोड़ पहुंच गया, जो पिछले साल ₹1,189 करोड़ था। वहीं सिर्फ जनवरी-मार्च तिमाही में मुनाफा 57.8% उछलकर ₹609 करोड़ हो गया। ICICI Pru Life Share में बुधवार को करीब 4 फीसदी से ज्यादा तेजी देखने को मिली।  मार्जिन और प्रोटेक्शन बिजनेस का कमाल  कंपनी के लिए सबसे बड़ी पॉजिटिव बात रही उसका VNB (Value of New Business), जो 10.9% बढ़कर ₹2,629 करोड़ पहुंच गया। VNB मार्जिन भी 24.7% पर मजबूत बना रहा। यह साफ संकेत है कि कंपनी का फोकस हाई मार्जिन प्रोडक्ट्स, खासकर प्रोटेक्शन सेगमेंट पर सही दिशा में जा रहा है।  GST रिफॉर्म्स के बाद इंश्योरेंस पॉलिसी सस्ती होने से रिटेल प्रोटेक्शन बिजनेस में जबरदस्त तेजी आई है। FY26 में इस सेगमेंट ने करीब 50% से ज्यादा ग्रोथ दर्ज की। कंपनी का कहना है कि यह ट्रेंड आगे भी जारी रह सकता है।  डिविडेंड से निवेशकों को राहत  एम्बेडेड वैल्यू (EV) भी 10.5% बढ़कर ₹52,989 करोड़ हो गई, जो कंपनी की लॉन्ग-टर्म वैल्यू क्रिएशन क्षमता को दर्शाती है। साथ ही कंपनी ने ₹1.65 प्रति शेयर का फाइनल डिविडेंड घोषित किया है, जो निवेशकों के लिए अतिरिक्त आकर्षण है।  ICICI Prudential Life पर HDFC Securities की राय  HDFC Securities ने Add रेटिंग के साथ ₹595 का टारगेट दिया है, जो करीब 8–10% अपसाइड का संकेत देता है। ब्रोकरेज का कहना है कि APE ग्रोथ भले ही कमजोर रही हो, लेकिन VNB ग्रोथ और मार्जिन में सुधार पॉजिटिव है। साथ ही वैल्यूएशन अभी भी आकर्षक दिख रहा है।  ICICI Prudential Life पर Goldman Sachs का स्टैंड  Goldman Sachs ने स्टॉक पर Neutral रुख रखा है और ₹600 का टारगेट दिया है, जो करीब 10–12% अपसाइड दर्शाता है। ब्रोकरेज के मुताबिक, मार्जिन में सुधार और बेहतर प्रोडक्ट मिक्स पॉजिटिव है, लेकिन हालिया बाजार उतार-चढ़ाव और कमजोर टॉपलाइन ट्रेंड के चलते ग्रोथ आउटलुक थोड़ा सतर्क बना हुआ है।  ICICI Prudential Life पर Motilal Oswal की कॉल  Motilal Oswal इस स्टॉक पर ज्यादा भरोसा जता रहा है और Buy रेटिंग के साथ ₹650 का टारगेट दिया है। यह मौजूदा स्तर से करीब 18–20% अपसाइड दिखाता है। ब्रोकरेज के अनुसार, VNB मार्जिन में तेज सुधार, प्रोटेक्शन बिजनेस की मजबूत ग्रोथ और बेहतर ऑपरेटिंग लीवरेज कंपनी के लिए बड़े ट्रिगर हैं।  ये भी पढ़ें: Aaj Ka Sensex, Nifty | Share Bazar LIVE: तेजी के साथ खुला बाजार, सेंसेक्स 1300 अंक भागा, निफ्टी 24,200 के पार, हर सेक्टर में हरियाली  ICICI Prudential Life पर Morgan Stanley का नजरिया  Morgan Stanley ने इस स्टॉक पर Overweight रेटिंग बरकरार रखी है और ₹670 का टारगेट दिया है। मौजूदा स्तर से यह करीब 22–25% का अपसाइड दिखाता है। ब्रोकरेज का मानना है कि VNB मार्जिन उम्मीद से बेहतर रहा है और प्रोटेक्शन मिक्स की वजह से आगे भी मार्जिन मजबूत रह सकते हैं, हालांकि पर्सिस्टेंसी ट्रेंड थोड़े कमजोर हैं।  ICICI Prudential Life पर Centrum Broking का आउटलुक  Centrum Broking ने Buy रेटिंग के साथ ₹697 का टारगेट दिया है, जो करीब 25–27% तक का अपसाइड दर्शाता है। ब्रोकरेज का कहना है कि Q4 में ग्रोथ की वापसी हुई है और आगे APE व VNB में डबल डिजिट ग्रोथ की उम्मीद है। बेहतर प्रोडक्ट मिक्स और कॉस्ट कंट्रोल से मार्जिन में और सुधार आ सकता है, जिससे स्टॉक में रीरैटिंग की गुंजाइश बनती है।  ये भी पढ़ें: Hero MotoCorp Share Price Target: हीरो मोटोकॉर्प में 18% तक कमाई का मौका, MOSL ने जारी किया प्राइस टारगेट  Disclaimer: शेयर को लेकर articles.title: NSE Report: बाजार से भाग रहे निवेशक, एक साल में 35 लाख ने छोड़ी ट्रेडिंग, जेरोधा टॉप लूजर
articles.summary: N SE Report के मुताबिक भारतीय शेयर बाजार में FY26 के दौरान निवेशकों का भरोसा डगमगाता नजर आया। NSE Market Data के हिसाब से एक्टिव Retail Investors की संख्या में रिकॉर्ड गिरावट दर्ज हुई है।
articles.body: करीब 35 लाख निवेशकों ने ट्रेडिंग से दूरी बना ली, जिसमें सबसे ज्यादा असर बड़े डिस्काउंट ब्रोकर्स पर देखने को मिला। वित्त वर्ष 2025-26 भारतीय शेयर बाजार के लिए निवेशक भागीदारी के लिहाज से कमजोर साबित हुआ। नेशनल स्टॉक एक्सचेंज के एक्टिव निवेशकों की संख्या 4.92 करोड़ से घटकर 4.58 करोड़ रह गई। यह करीब 7% की गिरावट है और पिछले तीन वर्षों में पहली बार ऐसा हुआ है जब निवेशकों की संख्या में सालाना आधार पर कमी आई है।  Zerodha, Angel One और Upstox पर सबसे ज्यादा असर  NSE Market Data के मुताबिक इस गिरावट में सबसे बड़ा योगदान प्रमुख डिस्काउंट ब्रोकरेज प्लेटफॉर्म्स का रहा। Zerodha ने करीब 9.95 लाख एक्टिव निवेशक खो दिए, जो कुल गिरावट का 29% है। Angel One के 8.15 लाख और Upstox के 7.6 लाख निवेशक कम हुए। तीनों कंपनियों ने मिलकर कुल गिरावट का 70% से ज्यादा हिस्सा बनाया, जो इस सेगमेंट में दबाव को साफ दर्शाता है।  अन्य ब्रोकरेज हाउस भी दबाव में  सिर्फ बड़े प्लेटफॉर्म ही नहीं, बल्कि अन्य ब्रोकरेज कंपनियां भी इस ट्रेंड से अछूती नहीं रहीं। Mirae Asset Capital Markets के करीब 2.7 लाख अकाउंट घटे, जबकि HDFC Securities और Sharekhan के लगभग 1.3-1.3 लाख निवेशक कम हुए। Motilal Oswal, Kotak Securities और 5paisa Capital ने भी उल्लेखनीय गिरावट दर्ज की।  बाजार की अस्थिरता ने बिगाड़ा निवेशकों का भरोसा  FY26 के दौरान में लगातार उतार-चढ़ाव देखने को मिला। ऊंचे वैल्यूएशन, कमजोर कॉरपोरेट नतीजे और विदेशी निवेशकों की लगातार बिकवाली ने सेंटीमेंट को कमजोर किया। इसके अलावा अमेरिका-ईरान-इजराइल तनाव और ट्रेड वॉर जैसे वैश्विक कारकों ने भी निवेशकों को सतर्क बना दिया।  IPO बाजार की कमजोरी भी बड़ी वजह  प्राइमरी मार्केट में भी निवेशकों को निराशा हाथ लगी। कई IPO लिस्टिंग उम्मीद के मुताबिक रिटर्न नहीं दे पाईं, जिससे रिटेल निवेशकों की दिलचस्पी कम हो गई। इसके साथ ही कच्चे तेल की कीमतों में उछाल ने महंगाई और आर्थिक स्थिरता को लेकर चिंता बढ़ाई।  विदेशी ब्रोकरेज ने भी घटाया भरोसा  वैश्विक ब्रोकरेज हाउस जैसे Nomura, Goldman Sachs और Morgan Stanley ने 2026 की शुरुआत में भारतीय बाजार पर रेटिंग घटाई। महंगे वैल्यूएशन, ऊंचे तेल दाम और AI सेक्टर में सीमित अवसरों को इसकी प्रमुख वजह बताया गया। Nomura ने Nifty 50 का टारगेट भी घटाकर 24,500-24,900 कर दिया।  कुछ ब्रोकरेज में बढ़े निवेशक, Paytm Money आगे  जहां एक ओर बड़े प्लेटफॉर्म्स पर गिरावट आई, वहीं कुछ मिड-साइज ब्रोकरेज ने नए निवेशक जोड़े। Paytm Money ने सबसे ज्यादा 2.12 लाख नए निवेशक जोड़े। इसके बाद SBICAP Securities और ICICI Securities ने भी क्रमशः 1.82 लाख और 1.41 लाख अकाउंट जोड़े।  बाजार में भरोसे की चुनौती  FY26 का डेटा साफ दिखाता है कि भारतीय शेयर बाजार में निवेशकों का भरोसा कमजोर हुआ है। बड़े ब्रोकरेज प्लेटफॉर्म्स पर भारी गिरावट यह संकेत देती है कि रिटेल निवेशक फिलहाल जोखिम से दूरी बना रहे हैं। आगे बाजार की स्थिरता ही निवेशकों की वापसी तय करेगी।  डिस्क्लेमर: TimesNow Hindi किसी स्टॉक, म्यूचुअल फंड, आईपीओ में निवेश की सलाह नहीं देता है। यहां पर केवल जानकारी दी गई है। निवेश से पहले अपने वित्तीय सलाहकार की राय जरूर लें।  Read more news like this on www.timesnowhindi.com

articles.title: Sensex rises 1400 points, investors earn Rs 9 lakh crore: Key factors behind why market is rising today
articles.summary: Aparna Deb  Why Is Share Market Rising Today? Frontline indices—the Sensex and Nifty 50—surged sharply in early trade on Wednesday, April 15, as strong buying interest lifted most sectors.
articles.body: The Sensex jumped over 1,400 points, or nearly 2%, to an intraday high of 78,270, while the Nifty 50 climbed more than 400 points to touch 24,281. Broader markets outperformed, with the Nifty Midcap 100 and Smallcap 100 indices rising over 2% each. Investor wealth also swelled significantly, with the total market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies increasing by ₹9 lakh crore to ₹458 lakh crore from ₹449 lakh crore in the previous session. What's Driving the Rally? 1. Fresh Hopes of US-Iran Talks Sentiment improved after reports indicated that the US and Iran may soon resume negotiations to resolve their conflict. According to reports, US President Donald Trump said discussions could restart in Pakistan within the next two days. The possibility of renewed diplomatic engagement helped calm nerves after earlier talks failed to deliver a breakthrough. 2. Sharp Correction in Crude Oil Prices Falling oil prices provided a strong tailwind for equities. Brent crude slipped below the $95 per barrel mark, with futures down about 0.4% to $94 after a nearly 5% drop in the previous session. US WTI crude also declined over 1% to $90, extending its recent sharp fall. VK Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist at Geojit Investments, noted that the sharp correction in crude alongside hopes of renewed talks is supporting markets, which appear to be pricing in a potential resolution to the conflict despite global recession concerns flagged by the IMF. 3. Strong Global Market Cues Global equities rallied, boosting domestic sentiment. MSCI's Asia-Pacific index (ex-Japan) rose 1.5% to a six-week high. Japan's Nikkei gained 1%, while South Korea's Kospi surged 3%. On Wall Street, the Nasdaq climbed 2% and the S&P 500 advanced 1.2%, nearing record highs. 4. Rupee Strengthens The Indian rupee also lent support to equities, rising 12 paise to 93.23 against the US dollar in early trade, aided by easing geopolitical tensions and softer crude prices. 5. Technical Breakout in Play Technical factors also contributed to the upside. According to Shrikant Chouhan of Kotak Securities, the Nifty 50 has been rebounding after recent declines, with 24,100 acting as a key resistance level. A sustained move above this mark could push the index towards 24,300, and potentially 24,500 if momentum holds.

articles.title: Sensex rallies 2,000 pts in two days since Monday's low: What lies ahead for Indian markets?
articles.summary: Given the improving undertone supported by recent recovery patterns, yet amid ongoing global uncertainties investors are advised to remain disciplined and selective, said an analyst
articles.body: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty posted a massive upmove from April 13 low amid hopes of renewed US-Iran talks. Sensex rose 2,000 points from Monday low while Nifty posted a near 3% rally. At 10:19 am on April 15, the Sensex was up 1,379.42 points or 1.8% at 78,226.99, and the Nifty was up 421.15 points or 1.77% at 24,263.80. About 3,233 shares advanced, 445 shares declined, and 144 shares were unchanged. This begs the question -- what lies ahead for Indian markets? "The smart recovery through Monday was consistent with the bullish expectations with which we had started the week. However, despite the strong close, oscillators appear less positioned to achieve the 24,400-24,900 objectives right away. This calls for volatility, prompting us to keep the downside marker far and wide at 23,760. That said, we will retain upside hopes while above 24,080," said Anand James, Chief Market Strategist, Geojit Investments Limited. "We believe 24,100/78,100 would act as a key resistance zone for traders. As long as the market trades below this level, weak sentiment is likely to continue. On the downside, it could retest the 23,600-23,500/76,600-76,300 levels. On the other hand, above 24,100/78,100, sentiment could change. Above this level, it could move towards 24,300/78,700. If Nifty closes above this level, further upside momentum could continue, taking the index to 24,500/79,300," said Shrikant Chouhan, Head Equity Research, Kotak Securities. US President Trump signalled a second round of US-Iran talks within two days, potentially to be hosted by Pakistan, to ease tensions in the Middle East. Brent crude plunged to $95 as supply disruption fears faded, while spot gold climbed above $4,800/oz on a softer dollar and risk-on sentiment post-cooler US inflation data, said Devarsh Vakil, Head of Prime Research at HDFC Securities about the triggers for market rally on April 15. The short-term trend of the Nifty remains strong, and the swing low at 23,555 is likely to act as a strong support going forward, while the 24,300-24,500 band poses near-term resistance, he said. Given the improving undertone supported by recent recovery patterns, yet amid ongoing global uncertainties and elevated volatility, investors are advised to remain disciplined and selective on April 15, 2026. Buying on dips in fundamentally strong stocks may remain a prudent strategy, as demand is visible at lower levels. However, fresh aggressive long positions should be considered only after a decisive breakout above key resistance zones, which would indicate strengthening sentiment and the potential for a more sustained bullish trend, said Hitesh Tailor, Technical Research Analyst, Choice Broking. On the daily chart, a strong bullish recovery candle was formed post the gap-down opening on April 13, suggesting demand absorption at lower levels and a potential shift in near-term sentiment, subject to follow-through buying. Technically, immediate support is seen at 23,900–24,000, while resistance is placed at 24,250–24,300, he said.

articles.title: Stock markets surge in early trade amid hopes of resumption of US-Iran peace talks
articles.summary: Mumbai, Apr 15 (PTI) Equity benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty surged in early trade on Wednesday, mirroring a rally in global markets and a drop
articles.body: in crude oil prices below the USD 100 per barrel mark, amid hopes of renewed diplomatic engagement between the US and Iran. The 30-share BSE Sensex jumped 1,422.85 points to 78,270.42 in early trade. The 50-share NSE Nifty climbed 438.25 points to 24,280.90. All the 30-Sensex firms were trading in positive territory during initial trade. InterGlobe Aviation, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Eternal, Larsen & Toubro and Bajaj Finance were the major gainers. Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, traded 0.26 per cent higher at USD 95.04 per barrel. "Markets appear to be looking past immediate risks and are instead pricing in the possibility of renewed diplomatic engagement between the US and Iran. This change in narrative has led to a sharp correction in crude oil prices, which is a key positive for India given its dependence on energy imports," Hariprasad K, Research Analyst and Founder, Livelong Wealth, said. US President Donald Trump has said that the war with Iran is "close to over", asserting that if he pulled up stakes right now, it would take Tehran 20 years to rebuild the country. "I think it's close to over, yeah. I view it as very close to being over," Trump told Fox News in an interview that will be telecast later Wednesday. A US media report said on Tuesday that Trump said that a second round of talks with Iran could be held in Islamabad "over the next two days". In Asian markets, South Korea's benchmark Kospi, Japan's Nikkei 225 index, Shanghai's SSE Composite index and Hong Kong's Hang Seng index were trading higher. US markets ended in positive territory on Tuesday. The Nasdaq Composite jumped 1.96 per cent, the S&P 500 climbed 1.18 per cent, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average edged higher by 0.66 per cent. "Hopes of resumption of US-Iran talks, Israel-Lebanon talks and crash in Brent crude by 10 dollars in two days augur well for the market in the near-term," V K Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Investments Limited, said. Stock markets were closed on Tuesday on account of Dr Baba Saheb Ambedkar Jayanti. Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) again offloaded equities worth Rs 1,983.18 crore on Monday after a day's breather, according to exchange data. Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) bought stocks worth Rs 2,432.30 crore. On Monday, the Sensex tumbled 702.68 points or 0.91 per cent to settle at 76,847.57. The Nifty plunged 207.95 points or 0.86 per cent to end at 23,842.65. PTI SUM HVA

articles.title: TVS Motor: દિલ્હી EV પોલિસીનો લાભ કે મોંઘા વેલ્યુએશનની ચિંતા?
articles.summary: TVS Motor Indiaના ઇલેક્ટ્રિક ટુ-વ્હીલર (EV 2W) માર્કેટમાં અગ્રણી સ્થાન ધરાવે છે. દિલ્હી સરકારની નવી EV પોલિસી, જે 2028થી પેટ્રોલ ટુ-વ્હીલર પર પ્રતિબંધ
articles.body: મૂકશે, તે TVS Motor માટે ફાયદાકારક સાબિત થઈ શકે છે. જોકે, કંપનીના ઊંચા વેલ્યુએશન (Valuation) રોકાણકારો માટે ચિંતાનો વિષય બન્યો છે.  Used by 10,000+ active investors  Select the stocks you want to track in real time.  Receive instant updates directly to WhatsApp.  દિલ્હીની EV પોલિસી TVS Motor માટે કેટલી મહત્વની?  દિલ્હી સરકારના નવા ડ્રાફ્ટ ઇલેક્ટ્રિક વ્હીકલ (EV) પોલિસીનો મુખ્ય ઉદ્દેશ EV અપનાવવાની ગતિને તેજ કરવાનો છે. આ નીતિ ખાસ કરીને ટુ-વ્હીલર અને થ્રી-વ્હીલર સેગમેન્ટને લક્ષ્યાંક બનાવે છે, જેમાં એપ્રિલ 2028 થી નવા પેટ્રોલ ટુ-વ્હીલરની નોંધણી પર પ્રતિબંધ મૂકવામાં આવશે અને જાન્યુઆરી 2027 થી નવા થ્રી-વ્હીલર માટે ઇલેક્ટ્રિક મોડેલ ફરજિયાત બનશે. TVS Motor, જે પહેલેથી જ FY26 માં યુનિટ વેચીને બજાર હિસ્સો ધરાવીને EV 2W માર્કેટમાં લીડર છે, તેને આ નીતિનો મોટો ફાયદો મળી શકે છે. માર્ચ 2026 માં કંપનીના EV રજીસ્ટ્રેશન દર્શાવે છે કે બજારમાં તેની મજબૂત પકડ છે.  ઊંચું વેલ્યુએશન રોકાણકારોને શા માટે ચિંતા કરાવે છે?  EV સેગમેન્ટમાં મજબૂત સ્થિતિ હોવા છતાં, TVS Motor નું ઊંચું વેલ્યુએશન રોકાણકારો માટે ચિંતાનો વિષય બન્યું છે. એપ્રિલ 2026 સુધીમાં, કંપનીનો પ્રાઈસ-ટુ-અર્નિંગ્સ (P/E) રેશિયો 63 થી 84 ની વચ્ચે રહ્યો હતો, જે Bajaj Auto (P/E ~ ) અને Maruti Suzuki (P/E ~ ) જેવા સ્પર્ધકો કરતાં ઘણો વધારે છે. આ ઊંચા વેલ્યુએશન સૂચવે છે કે રોકાણકારોએ પહેલેથી જ ભવિષ્યમાં નોંધપાત્ર વૃદ્ધિ, ખાસ કરીને EV વિસ્તરણમાંથી, ધ્યાનમાં લીધી છે. દિલ્હી પોલિસીની જાહેરાત પછી 13 એપ્રિલ 2026 ના રોજ, TVS Motor ના શેર ઘટ્યા હતા, જ્યારે Ather Energy જેવી EV-કેન્દ્રિત કંપનીઓમાં સુધીનો ઉછાળો જોવા મળ્યો હતો, જે વેલ્યુએશન અને અમલીકરણ અંગે રોકાણકારોની ચિંતા દર્શાવે છે.  સ્પર્ધકો અને એનાલિસ્ટના મંતવ્યો  FY26 માં, TVS Motor એ Bajaj Auto ( યુનિટ) અને Ather Energy ( યુનિટ) કરતાં વધુ EV ટુ-વ્હીલર વેચ્યા હતા. Ather Energy, જે મે 2025 માં સફળ IPO પછી માર્ચ 2026 સુધીમાં બજાર હિસ્સો ધરાવે છે, તે પ્રીમિયમ EV સેગમેન્ટમાં મુખ્ય સ્પર્ધક છે. બીજી તરફ, Ola Electric માર્ચ 2026 માં હિસ્સા સાથે પાંચમા સ્થાને આવી ગયું છે. મોટાભાગના એનાલિસ્ટ TVS Motor પર સકારાત્મક છે, જેમ કે Motilal Oswal દ્વારા ₹ અને Emkay દ્વારા ₹ ના ટાર્ગેટ પ્રાઈસ. જોકે, કેટલાક એનાલિસ્ટ ઊંચા વેલ્યુએશનને કારણે 'હોલ્ડ' (Hold) રેટિંગની સલાહ આપે છે.  બ્રોડર માર્કેટ અને ઈન્ફ્રાસ્ટ્રક્ચરના પડકારો  આગામી FY27 માં ભારતીય ઓટો ઉદ્યોગમાં વૃદ્ધિ ધીમી રહેવાની ધારણા છે, ICRA એ FY26 પછી નો વધારો predicted કર્યો છે. FY30 સુધીમાં EV અપનાવવામાં નોંધપાત્ર વૃદ્ધિની આગાહી છે, ખાસ કરીને ટુ- અને થ્રી-વ્હીલરમાં. જોકે, દેશભરમાં 13 લાખ થી વધુ ચાર્જિંગ સ્ટેશનોની જરૂરિયાત, ચાર્જરની વિશ્વસનીયતા અને કોમોડિટીના ભાવમાં વધારો જેવી પડકારો યથાવત છે. TVS Motor ના આઉટલુક માટેના જોખમો  TVS Motor તેના મજબૂત EV બજાર હિસ્સા અને સ્થાપિત સ્થિતિનો લાભ મેળવી રહી છે, પરંતુ કેટલાક જોખમો પર ધ્યાન આપવું જરૂરી છે. કંપનીનો P/E રેશિયો ઉદ્યોગની સરેરાશ કરતાં ઘણો વધારે છે, જે દર્શાવે છે કે સ્ટોક પહેલેથી જ ઊંચી વૃદ્ધિની અપેક્ષાઓને પ્રતિબિંબિત કરે છે. જો EV અપનાવવાની ગતિ આગાહી કરતાં ધીમી રહે, ચાર્જિંગ ઇન્ફ્રાસ્ટ્રક્ચરનો વિકાસ ધીમો પડે, અથવા EV સ્ટાર્ટઅપ્સ તરફથી સ્પર્ધા વધે, તો તેનું વેલ્યુએશન ઘટી શકે છે. દિલ્હી પોલિસીની જાહેરાત પછી શેરના ભાવમાં થયેલો ઘટાડો દર્શાવે છે કે બજાર તેના ઊંચા વેલ્યુએશન પ્રત્યે કેટલું સંવેદનશીલ છે. articles.title: Stock markets surge in early trade amid hopes of resumption of US-Iran peace talks
articles.summary: People walk past the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) building in Mumbai, India. (Photo: PTI)
articles.body: Mumbai, Apr 15 (PTI) Equity benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty surged in early trade on Wednesday, mirroring a rally in global markets and a drop in crude oil prices below the USD 100 per barrel mark, amid hopes of renewed diplomatic engagement between the US and Iran. The 30-share BSE Sensex jumped 1,422.85 points to 78,270.42 in early trade. The 50-share NSE Nifty climbed 438.25 points to 24,280.90. All the 30-Sensex firms were trading in positive territory during initial trade. InterGlobe Aviation, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Eternal, Larsen & Toubro and Bajaj Finance were the major gainers. Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, traded 0.26 per cent higher at USD 95.04 per barrel. “Markets appear to be looking past immediate risks and are instead pricing in the possibility of renewed diplomatic engagement between the US and Iran. This change in narrative has led to a sharp correction in crude oil prices, which is a key positive for India given its dependence on energy imports,” Hariprasad K, Research Analyst and Founder, Livelong Wealth, said. US President Donald Trump has said that the war with Iran is “close to over”, asserting that if he pulled up stakes right now, it would take Tehran 20 years to rebuild the country. “I think it’s close to over, yeah. I view it as very close to being over,” Trump told Fox News in an interview that will be telecast later Wednesday. A US media report said on Tuesday that Trump said that a second round of talks with Iran could be held in Islamabad “over the next two days”. In Asian markets, South Korea’s benchmark Kospi, Japan’s Nikkei 225 index, Shanghai’s SSE Composite index and Hong Kong’s Hang Seng index were trading higher. US markets ended in positive territory on Tuesday. The Nasdaq Composite jumped 1.96 per cent, the S&P 500 climbed 1.18 per cent, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average edged higher by 0.66 per cent. “Hopes of resumption of US-Iran talks, Israel-Lebanon talks and crash in Brent crude by 10 dollars in two days augur well for the market in the near-term,” V K Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Investments Limited, said. Stock markets were closed on Tuesday on account of Dr Baba Saheb Ambedkar Jayanti. Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) again offloaded equities worth Rs 1,983.18 crore on Monday after a day’s breather, according to exchange data. Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) bought stocks worth Rs 2,432.30 crore. On Monday, the Sensex tumbled 702.68 points or 0.91 per cent to settle at 76,847.57. The Nifty plunged 207.95 points or 0.86 per cent to end at 23,842.65.
quotes: K Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Investments Limited, said.

articles.title: Wipro Q4 Preview: PAT May Rise 2% QoQ; Q1 Guidance, Buyback, Dividend Announcement In Focus
articles.summary: Wipro Q4 Results: Brokerages expect a muted performance, with pressure on margins even as sequential growth remains intact.
articles.body: Wipro is set to announce its January–March quarter (Q4FY26) results on April 16. Brokerages expect a muted performance, with pressure on margins even as sequential growth remains intact.  Net profit is estimated at Rs 3,438.9 crore, down 3.66% year-on-year from Rs 3,569.6 crore. However, on a sequential basis, profit after tax is likely to rise 2.4% from Rs 3,357.47 crore reported in Q3FY26.  Revenue is projected to grow around 7% year-on-year to Rs 24,610.63 crore, compared to Rs 23,058.88 crore a year ago. Quarter-on-quarter, revenue may increase about 4% from Rs 23,586.55 crore.  Revenue Growth Supported by Inorganic Boost  A CNBC-TV18 poll suggests dollar revenue could rise 1.1% sequentially to $2,666 million, while rupee revenue may grow 4.1% quarter-on-quarter to Rs 24,343 crore.  However, profitability is expected to remain under pressure. EBIT is projected at Rs 4,158 crore, with margins likely to decline to 17.1% from 17.6% in the previous quarter.  Constant currency growth is expected to remain subdued at 0.4–0.5%, aided by the Harman DTS acquisition, which could contribute 1.5–2%. On an organic basis, revenue may decline about 1%, while margins are likely to contract by around 50 basis points.  What Brokerages Are Saying  Emkay Global Financial Services expects IT services revenue to grow 1.4% sequentially in dollar terms, supported by a 2% contribution from the Harman DTS acquisition and impacted by 40 basis points of cross-currency headwinds. Margins are likely to decline 70 basis points sequentially due to integration costs and wage hikes, although overall EBIT margin may improve 40 basis points quarter-on-quarter due to the absence of one-offs like restructuring costs.  Motilal Oswal Financial Services forecasts 1% constant currency growth, driven largely by inorganic contribution, while organic growth may decline 0.5% quarter-on-quarter. Margins are expected to contract 50 basis points to around 16%, impacted by acquisition-related dilution, wage hikes, and slower growth. BFSI and healthcare segments are seen stable, while consumer and EMR segments may remain under pressure due to tariff uncertainty and delayed decision-making.  Nuvama Institutional Equities estimates 0.5% constant currency growth and 1% sequential growth in dollar revenue, at the lower end of guidance. Margins are expected to decline 30 basis points due to integration and wage hikes, partly offset by forex gains. The brokerage expects Q1FY27 guidance in the range of -1% to +1% constant currency growth.  Dividend in Focus Amid Payout Commitment  The company is also expected to announce a dividend along with its results. Bloomberg-tracked estimates peg the FY26 dividend at around Rs 10.56 per share, with projections ranging widely between Rs 4 and Rs 17 per share.  This comes after Wipro indicated plans to distribute over 70% of its net income to shareholders between FY26 and FY28, putting this year's payout under close watch.  Buyback Expectations Add to Buzz  In addition to dividends, the board is expected to consider a share buyback—potentially the company's first in three years.  Brokerages estimate the buyback size could range between Rs 16,000 crore and Rs 18,500 crore. As of the December quarter, Wipro held cash reserves of Rs 41,510 crore, the highest among India's top five IT firms.  Morgan Stanley noted that a potential buyback is already factored in by the market, indicating limited surprise but continued investor interest in capital return measures.
quotes: absence of one-offs like restructuring costs.  Motilal Oswal Financial Services forecasts 1% constant currency

articles.title: LT Foods Share Price Target at Rs 500: Motilal Oswal
articles.summary: LT Foods has been suggested as BUY Call by research team at Motilal Oswal. LT Foods has successfully navigated tariff disruptions in the US, mitigated input cost pressures through strategic inventory management, and strengthened its balance sheet over the past decade. Despite near-term geopolitical and freight-related challenges, LT Foods’ diversified geographic exposure and premium product positioning provide resilience. With strong earnings visibility, improving margins, and structural tailwinds from trade normalization, the research house sees a compelling re-rating opportunity, maintaining a BUY call with a target price of Rs 500, implying 22% upside.
articles.body: Strategic Inflection: Multiple Catalysts Align for Re-Rating LT Foods is entering a high-conviction growth phase driven by external tailwinds and internal financial discipline. The company has demonstrated its ability to transform macro disruptions into structural opportunities, particularly in its key US market, which contributes approximately 46% of revenue. The reduction in US tariffs from 50% to 10% marks a decisive turning point. What was once a margin-dilutive headwind has now evolved into a structural tailwind, unlocking volume growth, margin recovery, and improved competitiveness versus global peers. US Business Resilience: Pricing Power Validated The company successfully passed on most of the 50% tariff burden to consumers. This highlights strong brand equity, particularly for flagship brands like Daawat and Royal, which enjoy significant stickiness among global consumers. Tariff normalization now enables three major advantages: Volume Upside: Competitive pricing can be reinstated in the US market. Margin Expansion: Partial recapture of earlier margin erosion. Competitive Parity: Indian basmati regains ground against Pakistani exports. This strategic shift positions LT Foods favorably in one of its most critical geographies. Input Cost Pressures: Managed Through Structural Strengths Basmati paddy prices have risen ~12% in the 2025 crop cycle, posing near-term margin pressure. Given that raw material costs constitute 70–80% of total expenses, this translates to an estimated 830–940 basis points gross margin headwind. However, LT Foods has demonstrated strong mitigation capabilities: Key cushioning factors include: Aged Inventory Model: Cost impact is staggered over 12–18 months. Premium Export Realizations: Export pricing (~Rs 144/kg) offers higher margin buffers versus domestic (~Rs 64/kg). Operational Discipline: Improved working capital cycle enhances financial flexibility. Notably, gross margins expanded to ~34% in 9MFY26 despite rising input costs, reflecting execution strength. Balance Sheet Transformation: A Decade of Financial Discipline LT Foods has delivered robust financial compounding over FY20–25. Revenue CAGR: ~16% Adjusted PAT CAGR: ~27% Free Cash Flow Generated: ~Rs 16 billion The company’s credit profile has significantly strengthened, leading to a CRISIL AA/Stable upgrade in February 2026. This marks a transition from a working-capital-heavy exporter to a globally diversified FMCG player. Additionally, working capital days improved meaningfully from 244 days in FY21 to 196 days in FY25, driven by better procurement and supplier credit strategies. Ecopure CVD Resolution: Major Overhang Significantly Reduced The US Department of Commerce reduced Ecopure’s countervailing duty from 340.27% to 75.48%. This sharp reduction lowers the potential liability from Rs 1.63 billion to approximately Rs 400 million. This development is critical for two reasons: De-risking of Organic Segment: Ecopure contributes ~11% of revenue. Restoration of Export Viability: Lower duty enables continued participation in the US market. The company is also exploring further legal remedies, indicating potential additional upside. Geopolitical Risks: Middle East Conflict Creates Short-Term Volatility The ongoing US–Israel–Iran conflict has disrupted global basmati trade flows. Approximately 400,000 MT of Indian basmati rice remains stuck in transit, while freight rates have surged 3–4x. Impact on LT Foods includes: Elevated logistics costs Delayed shipments and working capital stress Pressure on export margins However, mitigating factors remain: Strategic buffers include: Limited reliance on the Middle East (~9% revenue exposure) Strong North American presence Recent ceasefire easing logistical constraints Additionally, a 5–6% correction in basmati prices partially offsets input cost inflation. Global Demand Dynamics: Structural Growth Intact The basmati rice export market continues to expand steadily. According to the export table on page 6, total basmati exports increased from 39.4 million MT in 2021–22 to 52.4 million MT in 2023–24. Key export markets include: Saudi Arabia (~21% share) Iran (~11.6% share) Iraq (~15.2% share) This diversified demand base underpins long-term growth visibility. Financial Outlook and Growth Projections LT Foods is expected to deliver strong earnings growth over FY25–28: Revenue CAGR: ~17% EBITDA CAGR: ~18% PAT CAGR: ~18% Valuations remain attractive: FY28E P/E: ~14x EV/EBITDA: ~9x The company is valued at 17x FY28E EPS, supporting the target price of Rs 500. Investment Thesis: Strong Upside with Controlled Risks Key Investment Positives: Structural tailwinds from US tariff normalization Strong brand equity and pricing power Improving balance sheet and cash flows Reduced regulatory overhang (Ecopure) Diversified geographic exposure Key Risks: Sustained paddy price inflation Escalation in geopolitical tensions Freight cost volatility Currency fluctuations Stock Levels and Investor Strategy Current Market Price: Rs 410 Target Price: Rs 500 Upside Potential: ~22% Suggested Strategy: Accumulation Zone: Rs 390 – Rs 420 Short-Term Resistance: Rs 450 Medium-Term Target: Rs 500 Support Levels: Rs 360 – Rs 380 Recommendation: BUY with a medium-term investment horizon, as structural catalysts outweigh near-term volatility.
quotes: LT Foods Share Price Target at Rs 500: Motilal Oswal LT Foods has been suggested as BUY Call by research team at Motilal Oswal.

articles.title: TVS Motor: ਦਿੱਲੀ EV ਪਾਲਿਸੀ ਨਾਲ ਬੂਸਟ, ਪਰ ਮਹਿੰਗੇ ਮੁੱਲ ਨੇ ਨਿਵੇਸ਼ਕਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਵਧਾਈਆਂ ਚਿੰਤਾਵਾਂ
articles.summary: TVS Motor ਭਾਰਤ ਦੇ ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰਿਕ ਦੋ-ਪਹੀਆ (EV 2W) ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਬਦਬਾ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ। ਦਿੱਲੀ ਦੀ ਨਵੀਂ EV ਪਾਲਿਸੀ ਨਾਲ ਇਸ ਕੰਪਨੀ ਨੂੰ ਹੋਰ ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤੀ ਮਿਲਣ ਦੀ ਉਮੀਦ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਕੰਪਨੀ ਦਾ ਉੱਚਾ P/E ਰੇਸ਼ੋ ਨਿਵੇਸ਼ਕਾਂ ਲਈ ਵੱਡੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਦਾ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਬਣਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ।
articles.body: Used by 10,000+ active investors  Select the stocks you want to track in real time.  Receive instant updates directly to WhatsApp.  ਦਿੱਲੀ EV ਪਾਲਿਸੀ ਨਾਲ TVS Motor ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ ਕਿਨਾਰਾ?  ਦਿੱਲੀ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਲਿਆਂਦੀ ਗਈ ਨਵੀਂ ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰਿਕ ਵਾਹਨ (EV) ਪਾਲਿਸੀ, ਜੋ ਕਿ ਵਾਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਅਪਣੱਤ ਨੂੰ ਤੇਜ਼ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਨਵੇਂ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੋਤਸਾਹਨਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਕੇਂਦਰਿਤ ਹੈ, TVS Motor Company ਲਈ ਕਾਫੀ ਫਾਇਦੇਮੰਦ ਸਾਬਤ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਕੰਪਨੀ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ ਭਾਰਤ ਦੇ EV 2W ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਿੱਸੇਦਾਰੀ ਨਾਲ ਮੋਹਰੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨੇ FY26 ਵਿੱਚ ਯੂਨਿਟ ਵੇਚੇ ਹਨ।  ਇਹ ਪਾਲਿਸੀ ਖਾਸ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਦੋ- ਅਤੇ ਤਿੰਨ-ਪਹੀਆ ਵਾਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨਾ ਬਣਾਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਤਹਿਤ ਅਪ੍ਰੈਲ ਤੋਂ ਨਵੇਂ ਪੈਟਰੋਲ ਦੋ-ਪਹੀਆ ਵਾਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ 'ਤੇ ਪਾਬੰਦੀ ਲਗਾਈ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ ਅਤੇ ਜਨਵਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਨਵੇਂ ਤਿੰਨ-ਪਹੀਆ ਵਾਹਨਾਂ ਲਈ ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰਿਕ ਮਾਡਲ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਹੋਣਗੇ। ਇਸ ਨਾਲ TVS Motor ਦੇ ਮੁੱਖ ਉਤਪਾਦਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਸਿੱਧਾ ਅਸਰ ਪਵੇਗਾ। ਕੰਪਨੀ ਦੀ ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤ EV ਵਿਕਰੀ, ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਮਾਰਚ 2026 ਵਿੱਚ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਹਾਸਲ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ, ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਸਦੀ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਪਕੜ ਨੂੰ ਦਰਸਾਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।  ਉੱਚ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ (Valuation) ਕਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ TVS Motor ਨੂੰ ਪਰੇਸ਼ਾਨ  ਇਸਦੇ ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤ EV ਵਿਕਰੀ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ, TVS Motor ਦਾ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਨਿਵੇਸ਼ਕਾਂ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਵੱਡਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਦਾ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਬਣਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ। ਅਪ੍ਰੈਲ 2026 ਤੱਕ, ਕੰਪਨੀ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਈਸ-ਟੂ-ਅਰਨਿੰਗ (P/E) ਰੇਸ਼ੋ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਸੀ, ਜੋ ਇਸਦੇ ਮੁਕਾਬਲੇਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ Bajaj Auto (P/E ~ ), Maruti Suzuki (P/E ~ ), Hyundai India (~ ), ਅਤੇ Eicher Motors ( ) ਨਾਲੋਂ ਕਾਫੀ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਉੱਚਾ P/E ਰੇਸ਼ੋ ਦਰਸਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਨਿਵੇਸ਼ਕਾਂ ਨੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ ਕੰਪਨੀ ਦੇ ਭਵਿੱਖੀ ਵਿਕਾਸ, ਖਾਸ ਕਰਕੇ EV ਖੇਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ, ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਜ਼ਰੀਏ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ।  13 ਅਪ੍ਰੈਲ, 2026 ਨੂੰ ਦਿੱਲੀ ਪਾਲਿਸੀ ਦੇ ਐਲਾਨ ਦੇ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਬਾਅਦ, TVS Motor ਦੇ ਸ਼ੇਅਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੀ ਗਿਰਾਵਟ ਆਈ। ਇਸਦੇ ਉਲਟ, Ather Energy ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਸਿਰਫ EV 'ਤੇ ਕੇਂਦਰਿਤ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ੇਅਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੱਕ ਦਾ ਵਾਧਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਗਿਆ। ਇਹ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਕਿਰਿਆ ਦਰਸਾਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਨਿਵੇਸ਼ਕ ਪਾਲਿਸੀ ਦੇ ਲੰਬੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੇ ਲਾਭਾਂ ਨੂੰ TVS Motor ਦੇ ਉੱਚੇ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਅਤੇ ਇਸਦੇ ਰਵਾਇਤੀ ਗੈਸੋਲੀਨ-ਇੰਜਣ ਵਾਹਨ ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ 'ਤੇ ਪੈਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਸੰਭਾਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ ਤੋਲ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ।  ਪ੍ਰਤੀਯੋਗੀ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਲੇਸ਼ਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਰਾਏ  FY26 ਵਿੱਚ, TVS Motor ਨੇ Bajaj Auto ( ਯੂਨਿਟ) ਅਤੇ Ather Energy ( ਯੂਨਿਟ) ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ EV ਦੋ-ਪਹੀਆ ਵਾਹਨ ਵੇਚੇ। Ather Energy, ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਮਈ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਫਲ IPO ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਹੁਣ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ (ਮਾਰਚ 2026 ਤੱਕ) ਹਾਸਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ, ਪ੍ਰੀਮੀਅਮ EV ਸੈਗਮੈਂਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤ ਚੁਣੌਤੀ ਪੇਸ਼ ਕਰ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ। ਦੂਜੇ ਪਾਸੇ, Ola Electric ਨੇ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਹਿੱਸੇਦਾਰੀ ਗੁਆ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਰਚ 2026 ਵਿੱਚ ਹਿੱਸੇਦਾਰੀ ਨਾਲ ਪੰਜਵੇਂ ਸਥਾਨ 'ਤੇ ਆ ਗਈ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਨੁਕਸਾਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਖਰਚਿਆਂ ਕਾਰਨ ਵਿਸ਼ਲੇਸ਼ਕਾਂ ਤੋਂ 'Sell' ਰੇਟਿੰਗ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਕਰ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ।  ਵਿਸ਼ਲੇਸ਼ਕ ਆਮ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ TVS Motor ਨੂੰ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਸਕਾਰਾਤਮਕ ਹਨ, 'Buy' ਰੇਟਿੰਗਾਂ ਅਤੇ ₹4,500 (Motilal Oswal) ਅਤੇ ₹4,200 (Emkay) ਵਰਗੇ ਕੀਮਤ ਟੀਚੇ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ, ਜੋ EV ਵਿਕਾਸ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਰਯਾਤ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਸੰਭਾਵਨਾ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਹਨ। ਫਿਰ ਵੀ, ਕੁਝ ਵਿਸ਼ਲੇਸ਼ਕ ਉੱਚ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਕਾਰਨ 'Hold' ਦੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ। TVS Motor ਆਪਣੇ EV ਉਤਪਾਦ ਲਾਈਨ ਦਾ ਵਿਸਥਾਰ ਕਰਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਭਾਵਤ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਨਵਾਂ ਫੈਕਟਰੀ ਬਣਾ ਕੇ ਵਿਕਾਸ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਬਣਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ।  ਵਿਆਪਕ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਦੀਆਂ ਚੁਣੌਤੀਆਂ  ਸਮੁੱਚੀ ਭਾਰਤੀ ਆਟੋ ਇੰਡਸਟਰੀ FY27 ਵਿੱਚ ਹੌਲੀ ਵਿਕਾਸ ਦੇਖਣ ਦੀ ਉਮੀਦ ਹੈ, ICRA ਨੇ ਇੱਕ ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤ FY26 ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਹੋਲਸੇਲ ਵਾਲੀਅਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਾ ਵਾਧਾ ਪੇਸ਼ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ। EV ਅਪਣੱਤ FY30 ਤੱਕ ਕਾਫੀ ਵਧਣ ਦੀ ਭਵਿੱਖਬਾਣੀ ਹੈ, ਖਾਸ ਕਰਕੇ ਦੋ- ਅਤੇ ਤਿੰਨ-ਪਹੀਆ ਵਾਹਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ।  ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ, ਚੁਣੌਤੀਆਂ ਬਰਕਰਾਰ ਹਨ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਚਾਰਜਿੰਗ ਸਟੇਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਘਾਟ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੈ – ਭਾਰਤ ਨੂੰ 2030 ਤੱਕ 1.3 ਮਿਲੀਅਨ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਚਾਰਜਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੈ – ਅਤੇ ਚਾਰਜਰ ਦੀ ਭਰੋਸੇਯੋਗਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਪਦੰਡਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਬੰਧਤ ਮੁੱਦੇ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ, ਵਧ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਕੱਚੇ ਮਾਲ ਦੀਆਂ ਕੀਮਤਾਂ, ਜਿਸ ਕਾਰਨ Hyundai Motor India ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਕੀਮਤਾਂ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਬਣਾ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਲਾਭਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਫਾਇਤੀਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। TVS Motor ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ EV ਨਿਵੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਗੈਸੋਲੀਨ-ਸੰਚਾਲਿਤ ਵਾਹਨ ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ-ਨਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਿਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ, ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਆਰਥਿਕ ਚੁਣੌਤੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਪਵੇਗਾ।  ਨਵੀਂ ਪਾਲਿਸੀ ਦੀ ਸਫਲਤਾ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਚਾਰਜਿੰਗ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਅਤੇ ਉੱਚ EV ਕੀਮਤਾਂ ਦਾ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਖਪਤਕਾਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਇੱਛਾ 'ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਰ ਕਰੇਗੀ, ਜੋ ਨਿਰਮਾਤਾਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਿੱਧੇ ਨਿਯੰਤਰਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਹਰ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਕ ਹਨ।  TVS Motor ਦੇ ਆਉਟਲੁੱਕ ਲਈ ਖਤਰੇ  ਜਦੋਂ ਕਿ TVS Motor ਆਪਣੀ ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤ EV ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਹਿੱਸੇਦਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਥਾਪਿਤ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਤੋਂ ਲਾਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ, ਕਈ ਖਤਰੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਦੀ ਮੰਗ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਇਸਦਾ P/E ਰੇਸ਼ੋ, ਜੋ ਉਦਯੋਗ ਔਸਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਇਸਦੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅੰਕੜਿਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਹੈ, ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਸਟਾਕ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ ਉੱਚ ਵਿਕਾਸ ਉਮੀਦਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਦਰਸਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜੇਕਰ EV ਅਪਣੱਤ ਅਨੁਮਾਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਚਾਰਜਿੰਗ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਦਾ ਵਿਕਾਸ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਾਂ ਤੇਜ਼ EV ਸਟਾਰਟਅੱਪਸ ਤੋਂ ਮੁਕਾਬਲਾ ਵਧਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਇਸਦਾ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਡਿੱਗ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।  ਦਿੱਲੀ ਪਾਲਿਸੀ ਦੇ ਐਲਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਸਟਾਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਈ ਦੀ ਹਾਲੀਆ ਗਿਰਾਵਟ, EV-ਓਨਲੀ ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਹੋਏ ਲਾਭਾਂ ਦੇ ਉਲਟ, ਇਹ ਦਰਸਾਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਇਸਦੇ ਉੱਚ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਸੰਵੇਦਨਸ਼ੀਲ ਹੈ। ਹਾਲਾਂਕਿ ਵਿਸ਼ਲੇਸ਼ਕ ਆਮ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਸਟਾਕ ਨੂੰ ਸਕਾਰਾਤਮਕ ਰੇਟ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਕੁਝ ਕੀਮਤ ਟੀਚੇ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਪੱਧਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਹੋਰ ਕੀਮਤ ਵਾਧੇ ਦੀ ਸੀਮਤ ਸੰਭਾਵਨਾ ਦਾ ਸੁਝਾਅ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਦੋ-ਪਹੀਆ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ 'ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਰਤਾ, ਜੋ ਕਿ ਰੈਗੂਲੇਟਰੀ ਬਦਲਾਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਵਧ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਕੱਚੇ ਮਾਲ ਦੀਆਂ ਕੀਮਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਪੇਂਡੂ ਆਰਥਿਕ ਸਥਿਤੀਆਂ ਕਾਰਨ ਮੰਗ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੰਭਾਵੀ ਗਿਰਾਵਟ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਕਰ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ, TVS Motor ਦੇ ਆਉਟਲੁੱਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਗੁੰਝਲਤਾ ਜੋੜਦੀ ਹੈ।  Quarterly results, bulk deals, concall updates and major articles.title: Stock markets surge in early trade amid hopes of resumption of US-Iran peace talks
articles.summary: Indian equity markets rallied sharply Wednesday as Sensex and Nifty surged on global optimism and lower crude prices amid US-Iran diplomacy hopes. Gains were broad-based despite recent foreign outflows, with IT and aviation stocks leading the early advance across sectors
articles.body: Mumbai: Equity benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty surged in early trade on Wednesday, mirroring a rally in global markets and a drop in crude oil prices below the USD 100 per barrel mark, amid hopes of renewed diplomatic engagement between the US and Iran.  The 30-share BSE Sensex jumped 1,422.85 points to 78,270.42 in early trade. The 50-share NSE Nifty climbed 438.25 points to 24,280.90.  All the 30-Sensex firms were trading in positive territory during initial trade. InterGlobe Aviation, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Eternal, Larsen & Toubro and Bajaj Finance were the major gainers.  Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, traded 0.26 per cent higher at USD 95.04 per barrel.  “Markets appear to be looking past immediate risks and are instead pricing in the possibility of renewed diplomatic engagement between the US and Iran. This change in narrative has led to a sharp correction in crude oil prices, which is a key positive for India given its dependence on energy imports,” Hariprasad K, Research Analyst and Founder, Livelong Wealth, said.  US President Donald Trump has said that the war with Iran is “close to over”, asserting that if he pulled up stakes right now, it would take Tehran 20 years to rebuild the country.  “I think it's close to over, yeah. I view it as very close to being over,” Trump told Fox News in an interview that will be telecast later Wednesday.  A US media report said on Tuesday that Trump said that a second round of talks with Iran could be held in Islamabad “over the next two days”.  In Asian markets, South Korea's benchmark Kospi, Japan's Nikkei 225 index, Shanghai's SSE Composite index and Hong Kong's Hang Seng index were trading higher.  US markets ended in positive territory on Tuesday. The Nasdaq Composite jumped 1.96 per cent, the S&P 500 climbed 1.18 per cent, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average edged higher by 0.66 per cent.  “Hopes of resumption of US-Iran talks, Israel-Lebanon talks and crash in Brent crude by 10 dollars in two days augur well for the market in the near-term,” V K Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Investments Limited, said.  Stock markets were closed on Tuesday on account of Dr Baba Saheb Ambedkar Jayanti.  Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) again offloaded equities worth Rs 1,983.18 crore on Monday after a day's breather, according to exchange data. Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) bought stocks worth Rs 2,432.30 crore.  On Monday, the Sensex tumbled 702.68 points or 0.91 per cent to settle at 76,847.57. The Nifty plunged 207.95 points or 0.86 per cent to end at 23,842.65.
quotes: K Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Investments Limited, said.

articles.title: TVS Motor: ఢిల్లీ EV పాలసీతో జోష్.. కానీ వాల్యుయేషన్ తో ఇన్వెస్టర్లకు టెన్షన్!
articles.summary: ఢిల్లీ ప్రభుత్వం తీసుకొచ్చిన కొత్త ఎలక్ట్రిక్ వెహికల్ (EV) పాలసీ.. TVS Motor కంపెనీకి లాభదాయకంగా మారే అవకాశాలున్నాయి. అయితే, మార్కెట్లో ఈ కంపెనీ అధిక వాల్యుయేషన్ (Valuation) పెట్టుకున్న ఆందోళనలు ఇన్వెస్టర్లలో కనిపిస్తున్నాయి.
articles.body: Used by 10,000+ active investors  Select the stocks you want to track in real time.  Receive instant updates directly to WhatsApp.  ఢిల్లీలో ఎలక్ట్రిక్ వాహనాల (EV) వాడకాన్ని వేగవంతం చేసేందుకు ప్రభుత్వం ఒక కొత్త డ్రాఫ్ట్ పాలసీని విడుదల చేసింది. ఈ పాలసీ ప్రకారం, 2028 ఏప్రిల్ నుంచి అన్ని కొత్త టూ-వీలర్లు ఎలక్ట్రిక్ అయి ఉండాలి, 2027 జనవరి నుంచి కొత్త త్రీ-వీలర్లు కూడా ఎలక్ట్రిక్ లోనే రావాలి. ఈ నిర్ణయాలు TVS Motor Companyకి ఎంతగానో కలిసిరానున్నాయి.  ఇప్పటికే, TVS Motor ఇండియాలో EV 2W మార్కెట్లో వాటాతో ముందుంది. FY26లో యూనిట్లను విక్రయించింది. మార్చి 2026 నాటికి కూడా కొత్త EV రిజిస్ట్రేషన్లతో తన ఆధిక్యతను చాటుకుంది.  అయితే, మార్కెట్లో TVS Motor యొక్క వాల్యుయేషన్ (Valuation) విషయంలో ఇన్వెస్టర్లు ఆందోళన చెందుతున్నారు. ప్రస్తుత P/E రేషియో మధ్య ఉంది. ఇది Bajaj Auto (P/E ~ ), Maruti Suzuki (P/E ~ ), Hyundai India (~ ), Eicher Motors ( ) వంటి పోటీదారుల కంటే చాలా ఎక్కువ. అంటే, కంపెనీ భవిష్యత్ వృద్ధిని, ముఖ్యంగా EV రంగంలో రాణించడాన్ని ఇప్పటికే ఇన్వెస్టర్లు అధిక ధరల్లోనే పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకున్నారని అర్థం.  ఈ పాలసీ ప్రకటన వచ్చిన ఏప్రిల్ 13, 2026న, TVS Motor షేర్లు పడిపోయాయి. ఇదే సమయంలో, Ather Energy వంటి పూర్తిగా EVలపైనే దృష్టి సారించిన కంపెనీల షేర్లు వరకు పెరిగాయి. ఇది ఇన్వెస్టర్లు TVS Motor యొక్క అధిక వాల్యుయేషన్, దాని అమలు సామర్థ్యంపై ఆందోళన చెందుతున్నారని స్పష్టం చేస్తోంది.  FY26లో TVS Motor, Bajaj Auto ( యూనిట్లు), Ather Energy ( యూనిట్లు) కంటే ఎక్కువ EV టూ-వీలర్లను విక్రయించింది. అయితే, Ather Energy మార్కెట్లో వాటాతో (March 2026 నాటికి) కీలక పోటీదారుగా మారింది. Ola Electric మాత్రం మార్కెట్లో నాలుగో స్థానానికి పడిపోయింది.  చాలా మంది అనలిస్టులు TVS Motorపై పాజిటివ్ గానే ఉన్నప్పటికీ, Motilal Oswal ₹4,500 , Emkay ₹4,200 వంటి టార్గెట్ ప్రైస్ లను సూచిస్తున్నారు. కొందరు మాత్రం అధిక వాల్యుయేషన్ కారణంగా 'హోల్డ్' చేయమని సలహా ఇస్తున్నారు. కొత్త EV ఫ్యాక్టరీ, ఉత్పత్తి శ్రేణి విస్తరణ వంటి ప్రణాళికలతో కంపెనీ వృద్ధిని పెంచుకోవాలని చూస్తోంది.  భారత ఆటో రంగం FY27లో మందగమనంతో నడుస్తుందని, FY26తో పోలిస్తే వృద్ధి గానే ఉంటుందని ICRA అంచనా వేస్తోంది. EVలకు ఛార్జింగ్ స్టేషన్ల కొరత (2030 నాటికి 13 లక్షలకు పైగా అవసరం), కమోడిటీ ధరల పెరుగుదల (ఇది ధరల పెంపుకు దారితీయవచ్చు) వంటివి EVల విస్తరణకు అడ్డంకులుగా ఉన్నాయి.  TVS Motor అధిక EV మార్కెట్ వాటాను కలిగి ఉన్నప్పటికీ, కొన్ని రిస్కులు ఉన్నాయి. స్టాక్ ఇప్పటికే అధిక వృద్ధి అంచనాలను ప్రతిబింబిస్తోంది. EVల స్వీకరణ అంచనాల కంటే తక్కువగా ఉంటే, ఛార్జింగ్ మౌలిక సదుపాయాల అభివృద్ధి నెమ్మదిస్తే, లేదా పోటీ తీవ్రమైతే, దాని వాల్యుయేషన్ దెబ్బతినవచ్చు. కాంపిటీషన్, గ్రామీణ ఆర్థిక పరిస్థితుల ప్రభావం కూడా కంపెనీ భవిష్యత్తుపై ప్రభావం చూపవచ్చు. articles.title: Adani Power Ltd Aktie (INE814H01011): Ist der Fokus auf erneuerbare Energien stark genug für nachhaltiges Wachstum?
articles.summary: Adani Power Ltd INE814H01011  Adani Power Ltd Aktie (INE814H01011): Ist der Fokus auf erneuerbare Energien stark genug für nachhaltiges Wachstum?
articles.body: 15.04.2026 - 07:00:28 | ad-hoc-news.de  Kann Adani Power mit seiner Expansion in Solar- und Windkraft den Übergang zu grüner Energie meistern? Für Anleger in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz bietet die indische Stromversorger-Aktie Chancen durch globale Energiewende-Trends. ISIN: INE814H01011  Adani Power Ltd, INE814H01011 - Foto: THN  Adani Power Ltd treibt als einer der führenden Stromerzeuger Indiens die Energiewende voran, indem es massiv in erneuerbare Energien investiert. articles.summary: TVS Motor इंडियातील इलेक्ट्रिक टू-व्हीलर (EV 2W) मार्केटमध्ये आघाडीवर आहे. FY26 मध्ये **3,41,647 युनिट्स** विकून **24%** मार्केट शेअर
articles.body: मिळवला आहे. आता दिल्ली सरकारने नवीन EV पॉलिसी जाहीर केली आहे, जी एप्रिल 2028 पासून टू-व्हीलर्स पूर्णपणे इलेक्ट्रिक करण्यावर भर देते. यामुळे EV गाड्यांचा वापर वाढण्याची अपेक्षा आहे. मात्र, TVS Motor चा सध्याचा P/E रेशो **63** ते **84** इतका जास्त आहे, जो Bajaj Auto (P/E ~**27-31**) आणि Maruti Suzuki (P/E ~**26-29**) सारख्या प्रतिस्पर्ध्यांपेक्षा खूप जास्त आहे. या धोरणाची घोषणा झाल्यावर TVS चे शेअर्स **3-5%** घसरले, तर Ather Energy सारख्या EV कंपन्यांच्या शेअर्समध्ये वाढ दिसून आली. यामुळे गुंतवणूकदारांना TVS Motor च्या उच्च व्हॅल्युएशन आणि अंमलबजावणी क्षमतेबद्दल चिंता वाटत आहे.  Used by 10,000+ active investors  Select the stocks you want to track in real time.  Receive instant updates directly to WhatsApp.  दिल्ली EV पॉलिसीचा TVS Motor ला फायदा?  दिल्ली सरकारची नवी इलेक्ट्रिक व्हेईकल (EV) पॉलिसी EV उद्योगाला गती देण्याच्या उद्देशाने आणली गेली आहे. या पॉलिसीमध्ये टू-व्हीलर्स आणि थ्री-व्हीलर्ससाठी नवीन नियम आणि प्रोत्साहनं समाविष्ट आहेत. विशेषतः, एप्रिल 2028 पासून नवीन पेट्रोल टू-व्हीलर वाहनांच्या नोंदणीवर बंदी घालण्यात येणार असून, जानेवारी 2027 पासून नवीन थ्री-व्हीलर्ससाठी इलेक्ट्रिक मॉडेल अनिवार्य असतील. यामुळे TVS Motor Company सारख्या कंपन्यांना मोठा फायदा होण्याची अपेक्षा आहे. TVS Motor आधीच इंडियातील इलेक्ट्रिक टू-व्हीलर (EV 2W) मार्केटमध्ये मार्केट शेअरसह आघाडीवर आहे. FY26 मध्ये कंपनीने 3,41,647 युनिट्स विकले आहेत. मार्च 2026 मध्ये त्यांची 49,453 नोंदणी ही त्यांच्या बाजारातील मजबूत पकड दर्शवते.  उच्च व्हॅल्युएशनची चिंता  EV मार्केटमध्ये आघाडीवर असूनही, TVS Motor चे व्हॅल्युएशन गुंतवणूकदारांसाठी चिंतेचा विषय बनले आहे. एप्रिल 2026 मध्ये कंपनीचा प्राइस-टु-अर्निंग्स (P/E) रेशो ते या दरम्यान होता. हा रेशो Bajaj Auto (P/E ), Maruti Suzuki (P/E ), Hyundai India (~ ) आणि Eicher Motors ( ) यांसारख्या प्रतिस्पर्ध्यांच्या तुलनेत खूप जास्त आहे. हे उच्च व्हॅल्युएशन दर्शवते की गुंतवणूकदारांनी आधीच कंपनीच्या EV विस्तारातून होणाऱ्या मोठ्या वाढीची अपेक्षा गृहीत धरली आहे.  शेअर बाजारातील प्रतिक्रिया  13 एप्रिल 2026 रोजी दिल्ली EV पॉलिसीच्या घोषणेनंतर TVS Motor च्या शेअर्समध्ये ची घसरण दिसून आली. याउलट, Ather Energy सारख्या पूर्णपणे EV वर लक्ष केंद्रित करणाऱ्या कंपन्यांच्या शेअर्समध्ये पर्यंत वाढ झाली. ही प्रतिक्रिया दर्शवते की गुंतवणूकदार पॉलिसीच्या दीर्घकालीन फायद्यांबरोबरच TVS Motor च्या उच्च व्हॅल्युएशन आणि पारंपरिक पेट्रोल वाहनांवरील परिणामांचे मूल्यांकन करत आहेत.  प्रतिस्पर्धी आणि विश्लेषकांचे मत  FY26 मध्ये, TVS Motor ने Bajaj Auto ( 2,90,000 युनिट्स ) आणि Ather Energy ( 2,40,000 युनिट्स ) सारख्या प्रतिस्पर्धकांना मागे टाकत EV 2W विक्रीत आघाडी घेतली. मे 2025 मध्ये यशस्वी IPO नंतर मार्केट शेअर मिळवलेल्या Ather Energy कडून प्रीमियम EV सेगमेंटमध्ये मोठी स्पर्धा आहे. Ola Electric मात्र घसरले असून मार्च 2026 मध्ये शेअरसह पाचव्या स्थानी आले आहे.  अनेक विश्लेषक TVS Motor च्या भविष्याबद्दल सकारात्मक आहेत. Motilal Oswal ने ₹4,500 आणि Emkay ने ₹4,200 चा टार्गेट प्राईस दिला आहे, ज्यात EV वाढ आणि निर्यात सुधारण्याची क्षमता दिसत आहे. तथापि, उच्च व्हॅल्युएशनमुळे काही विश्लेषक 'होल्ड' (Hold) करण्याचा सल्ला देत आहेत. TVS Motor नवीन फॅक्टरी आणि EV उत्पादनांच्या विस्तारासह वाढीला गती देण्याची योजना आखत आहे.  बाजारातील आव्हाने आणि जोखीम  FY27 मध्ये भारतीय ऑटो उद्योगात ची मंद वाढ अपेक्षित आहे. FY30 पर्यंत EV चा वापर लक्षणीयरीत्या वाढण्याचा अंदाज आहे, विशेषतः टू- आणि थ्री-व्हीलर सेगमेंटमध्ये. तथापि, पर्यंत 13 लाख पेक्षा जास्त चार्जिंग स्टेशन्सची गरज आणि त्यांच्या विश्वासार्हतेसारखी आव्हाने आहेत. तसेच, कमोडिटीच्या वाढत्या किमतींमुळे वाहनांच्या किमती वाढू शकतात, ज्यामुळे परवडण्यावर परिणाम होईल.  TVS Motor साठी सर्वात मोठी जोखीम त्याचे उच्च P/E रेशो आहे, जे आधीच जास्त वाढीची अपेक्षा दर्शवते. जर EV दत्तक घेण्याचा वेग अपेक्षेपेक्षा कमी राहिला, चार्जिंग इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चरचा विकास मंदावला किंवा स्पर्धकांनी जोर पकडला, तर कंपनीचे व्हॅल्युएशन कमी होऊ शकते. टू-व्हीलर मार्केटवरील अवलंबित्व, नियामक बदल आणि ग्रामीण भागातील मागणीतील घट यासारख्या घटकांमुळे TVS Motor च्या भविष्यातील वाटचालीत गुंतागुंत वाढू शकते.
